<?php
$before = new class {};
class Ctor179Early {
    public function __construct(int $value = 3) {
        $child = new class($value) {
            public function __construct(public int $value) {}
            public function read(): int { return $this->value; }
        };
        echo $child::class, ';', $child->read(), ';';
    }
}
$after = new class {};
new Ctor179Early;
new Ctor179Early(8);
echo $before::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
$before = new class {};
if (true) {
    class Ctor179Conditional {
        public function __construct() {
            $child = new class {};
            echo $child::class, ';';
        }
    }
}
$after = new class {};
new Ctor179Conditional;
echo $before::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
class Ctor179Base {
    protected function __construct(int $value) { echo 'BASE;', $value, ';'; }
}
class Ctor179Derived extends Ctor179Base {
    public function __construct() {
        echo 'OWNER;';
        $child = new class(4) extends Ctor179Base {};
        echo $child::class, ';';
    }
}
new Ctor179Derived;

<?php
class Ctor179Parent {
    public function __construct() { echo 'PARENT;'; }
}
class Ctor179Promoted extends Ctor179Parent {
    public function __construct(public int $value) {
        echo 'OWNER;', $this->value, ';';
        $child = new class($this->value) {
            public function __construct(public int $value) { echo 'CHILD;', $this->value, ';'; }
        };
        parent::__construct();
        echo $child->value, ';';
    }
}
new Ctor179Promoted(7);

<?php
class Ctor179PrivateChild {
    public function __construct() {
        echo 'OWNER;';
        $child = new class((print 'ARG;')) {
            private function __construct(int $value) { echo 'CHILD;'; }
            public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD-DTOR;'; }
        };
        echo 'BAD;';
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER-DTOR;'; }
}
new Ctor179PrivateChild;

<?php
class Ctor179FinalBase { final public function value(): int { return 1; } }
class Ctor179FinalOwner {
    public function __construct() {
        echo 'OWNER;';
        $child = new class((print 'ARG;')) extends Ctor179FinalBase {
            public function __construct(int $value) { echo 'CHILD;'; }
            public function value(): int { return 2; }
        };
    }
}
echo 'BEFORE;';
new Ctor179FinalOwner;
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class Ctor179SkippedBase { final public function value(): int { return 1; } }
class Ctor179SkippedOwner {
    public function __construct() {
        if (false) {
            $child = new class extends Ctor179SkippedBase {
                public function value(): int { return 2; }
            };
        }
        echo 'DONE;';
    }
}
new Ctor179SkippedOwner;

<?php
class R179SensitiveBase { final public function value(): int { return 1; } }
class R179SensitiveOwner {
 public function __construct() {
  $child = new class extends R179SensitiveBase { public function value(): int { return 2; } };
 }
}
function r179SensitiveCaller(#[SensitiveParameter] string $secret): void { new R179SensitiveOwner; }
r179SensitiveCaller('hidden');

<?php
class Ctor179BadDefault {
    public function __construct() {
        $child = new class {
            public function bad(int $value = 'bad') {}
        };
    }
}
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class Ctor179Static {
    public static function __construct() {
        $child = new class {};
    }
}
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class Ctor179StaticPriority {
    public static function __construct() {
        $child = new class {
            public function bad(int $value = 'bad') {}
        };
    }
}
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
class Ctor179PrivateOwner {
    private function __construct() {
        $child = new class {
            public function read(): int { return 12; }
        };
        echo 'PRIVATE;', $child->read(), ';';
    }
    public static function make(): self { return new self; }
}
Ctor179PrivateOwner::make();

<?php
class Ctor179ThrowOwner {
    public object $child;
    public function __construct() {
        $this->child = new class {
            public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD-DTOR;'; }
        };
        echo 'MADE;';
        throw new Exception('stop');
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER-DTOR;'; }
}
try { new Ctor179ThrowOwner; } catch (Exception $error) { echo 'CAUGHT;'; }
echo 'END;';

<?php
class R179StaticWarn {
 static function __construct() {
   $child = new class { private final function f() {} };
 }
}
echo 'BAD;';

 public function __construct(): int {
  $child = new class {};
 }
}

 }
